title: US IT Recruiter
description:
Manage the end-to-end US IT recruitment lifecycle, from requirement understanding to candidate onboarding. Work on a variety of technical roles across different technologies and domains in the US staffing market. Source, screen, and submit qualified candidates using job portals, internal databases, professional networks, and other sourcing channels. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of candidates through continuous sourcing and relationship management. Ensure all submissions are well-qualified and aligned with client requirements to improve submission-to-interview and interview-to-hire ratios. Maintain accurate and detailed notes for every candidate interaction in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Coordinate interview schedules, provide timely updates to candidates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the hiring process. Follow up consistently with candidates to avoid interview drop-offs and ensure successful onboarding. Use Boolean search techniques and creative sourcing strategies to identify high-quality candidates. Manage multiple job requirements simultaneously while meeting defined productivity and quality targets. Collaborate with team members and support knowledge sharing to improve overall team performance. Stay updated with current IT technologies, market trends, and recruitment best practices in the US staffing industry. Maintain professional communication with candidates and internal stakeholders at all times. 
Eligibility Criteria
 2 to 6 years of experience in US IT Recruitment within the staffing industry. Hands-on experience working with Implementation Partners or Direct Clients in the US staffing environment. Strong understanding of the US IT recruitment process, technical roles, and hiring workflows. Proven ability to source candidates using multiple channels such as job portals, databases, and professional networks. Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Ceipal, JobDiva, Bullhorn, or similar tools. Familiarity with VMS platforms such as Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar systems is preferred. Ability to manage multiple requirements in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Good organizational skills with attention to detail in maintaining candidate records and follow-ups. Willingness to work night shifts (Eastern Hours) from office on a full-time basis. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment. 
 Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume at E-Mail: poojag@codeforce.com Number : 9100118350

TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST 
 Job Description 
 Company 
 Indraprasstha Green Energy LLP 
 Human Resources 
 Department 
 Employment Type 
 Role 
 Full-Time 
 Talent Acquisition Specialist 
 Job Summary 
 The Talent Acquisition Specialist will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment activities while also 
 supporting key HR operations including onboarding, payroll coordination, attendance management, and statutory 
 compliance. The role will ensure timely hiring of quality talent, smooth joining processes, accurate payroll inputs, 
 proper employee documentation, and adherence to applicable labour laws and company policies. 
 Talent Acquisition & Recruitment 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned positions, from understanding manpower requirements through 
 offer acceptance and joining. 
 
 Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, professional 
 networks, and other relevant channels. 
 
 Screen resumes, conduct preliminary discussions, assess candidate suitability, and prepare shortlists for hiring 
 managers. 
 
 Coordinate interviews, assessments, feedback, reference checks, and selection processes. 
 
 Maintain an active talent pipeline for critical and recurring positions. 
 
 Prepare and issue offer letters and coordinate salary discussions and joining formalities. 
 
 Track recruitment metrics such as open positions, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, offer-to-joining ratio, and 
 hiring status. 
 
 Build a strong candidate experience and maintain professional communication throughout the recruitment cycle. 
 
 Employee Onboarding & HR Operations 
 Coordinate pre-joining documentation, background verification, induction, and onboarding activities. 
 
 Ensure timely creation and maintenance of employee files, HRMS records, and personnel documentation. 
 
 Coordinate employee offboarding, exit documentation, full-and-final inputs, and exit interviews. 
 
 Support employee engagement initiatives and address routine employee queries professionally. 
 
 Maintain confidentiality of employee and recruitment information. 
 
 Payroll & Attendance 
 Coordinate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, incentives, 
 deductions, and other employee changes. 
 
 Verify attendance, leave records, timesheets, and payroll-related data for accuracy before processing. 
 
 Liaise with payroll service providers or internal finance teams to ensure timely and accurate salary processing. 
 
 Support resolution of employee payroll and salary-related queries. 
 
 Assist in maintaining payroll records and reconciliation of payroll-related information. 
 
 Statutory Compliance 
 Support compliance with applicable labour and employment laws, rules, and company policies. 
 
 
 
 Coordinate statutory payroll-related requirements such as PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, and other applicable 
 deductions and filings, as relevant to the organization. 
 
 Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, declarations, and compliance records as required. 
 
 
 Coordinate with external consultants, payroll vendors, and relevant authorities for routine statutory compliance 
 matters. 
 Track compliance calendars, renewal dates, filings, payments, and documentation to help ensure timely 
 completion. 
 
 Assist with audits, inspections, notices, and statutory documentation when required. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 
 
 
 MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. 
 25 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruitment with exposure to payroll and statutory 
 compliance. 
 Experience in independently handling recruitment mandates and coordinating with hiring managers. 
 Hands-on exposure to payroll inputs, attendance, employee records, and statutory HR processes preferred. 
 
 
 Required Skills 
 Strong sourcing, interviewing, candidate assessment, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. 
 Working knowledge of recruitment portals, LinkedIn, HRMS, and MS Office/Google Workspace. 
 Practical understanding of payroll processes and statutory compliance requirements. 
 Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate HR and compliance documentation. 
 Good organizational, multitasking, follow-up, and time-management abilities. 
 High level of confidentiality, integrity, professionalism, and ownership. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Time-to-fill and time-to-hire for open positions. 
 
 Quality of hire and offer-to-joining ratio. 
 
 Recruitment pipeline strength and source effectiveness. 
 
 Recruitment cost and agency/source performance, where applicable. 
 
 Onboarding completion and candidate/employee experience. 
 
 Payroll input accuracy and timeliness. 
 
 Attendance and employee-record accuracy. 
 
 Timely completion of statutory filings, payments, registers, and compliance documentation.

Resolve employee queries related to attendance, leave, and payroll. Maintain accurate leave and attendance records. D. Employee Relations
